title: Protected objects
subtitle: Mailboxes, OneDrives and IMAP accounts in scope, and the rules that decide it.
tenantScope: Mailboxes, OneDrives and IMAP accounts of {tenant}, and the rules that decide what is protected.

noTenant.title: No tenant selected
noTenant.description: Choose a tenant in the switcher at the top to see its protected objects.

statusHint.active: In scope: backups run for this object.
statusHint.excluded: Out of scope by rule or by an individual decision: no new backups run.
statusHint.orphaned: No longer in the directory or no longer provisioned. Existing backups stay until retention removes them.
statusHint.not_selected: The scope is "Only selected objects" and nobody chose this object: no new backups run. Existing backups, if any, stay until retention removes them.
statusHint.needs_credential: In scope, but this account has no password of its own set and working yet: no backup can run until one is set under Login and tested.

override.includeHint: An admin decided to protect this object regardless of the rules.
override.excludeHint: An admin decided to leave this object out regardless of the rules.

sharedOrBlocked.label: Shared or blocked
sharedOrBlocked.hint: Sign-in is disabled for this account: a shared or resource mailbox, or a blocked user. Microsoft Graph does not tell them apart.

readiness.unverifiedHint: Backups exist, but no test restore has confirmed them yet. An unverified backup does not count as protected.
readiness.noneHint: There is nothing to verify until the first backup completed.
readiness.needsCredentialHint: This account has no password of its own set and working right now, so it is not currently protected, whatever an earlier restore point once proved.

backup.failedHint: The most recent backup run failed {when}. Open the run for the reason.
backup.failedWhen: The most recent backup run failed {when}.

hint.missing: This account has no password of its own yet; it is not protected until one is set.
hint.untested: A password is set but has not been tried against the server yet.
hint.failed: The last test-login failed; see the reason below.

credential.setDescription: Stored encrypted with the tenant key and never shown again. Only meaningful for a source with one password per mailbox.

probeReasons.blocked_address: This server is in a loopback, private or link-local network, which {appName} does not connect to from here.
probeReasons.auth: The server rejected the username or password.
probeReasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
probeReasons.starttls_unavailable: The server does not offer STARTTLS on this port.
probeReasons.dns: The hostname could not be resolved.
probeReasons.unknown: The connection failed for an unexpected reason.

errors.imapNotPerMailbox: This account's source authenticates every mailbox with its own stored credential; it has no password of its own to set or test.
errors.imapCredentialNotConfigured: This mailbox has no password yet; set one first.

empty.title: No protected objects yet
empty.description: Connect a Microsoft 365 tenant and run a directory sync, or add accounts to an IMAP source.

objects.error: Protected objects could not be loaded

actions.failed: The change could not be saved.

excludeConfirm.title: Exclude {name} from backup?
excludeConfirm.description: No new backups run for this object. Existing backups stay until retention removes them.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name}?
removeConfirm.description: The account leaves the list. It has no backups, so nothing else is removed.

blocked.title: This mailbox cannot be deleted
blocked.backups: This mailbox has backups, so it cannot be deleted; {appName} never deletes backups on the side.
blocked.hold: This mailbox has backups or a legal hold, so it cannot be deleted; {appName} never deletes backups or held data on the side.
blocked.retention: Exclude it from protection instead: no new backups run, existing restore points stay restorable and expire according to your retention settings.
blocked.alreadyExcluded: It is already excluded from protection. Existing restore points stay restorable and expire according to your retention settings.

bulk.selectPage: Select all rows on this page

include.title: {count, plural, one {Include # object?} other {Include # objects?}}
include.description: {count, plural, one {The object is} other {The objects are}} always protected from now on, regardless of the rules, until an admin changes that decision.

exclude.title: {count, plural, one {Exclude # object from backup?} other {Exclude # objects from backup?}}
exclude.description: No new backups run for {count, plural, one {the object} other {the objects}}. Existing backups stay until retention removes them.

reset.title: {count, plural, one {Follow the rules again for # object?} other {Follow the rules again for # objects?}}
reset.description: Individual decisions are removed; the source's protection rules decide {count, plural, one {the object} other {the objects}} again after the next directory sync.

done.include: {count, plural, one {# object included.} other {# objects included.}}
done.exclude: {count, plural, one {# object excluded from backup.} other {# objects excluded from backup.}}
done.reset: {count, plural, one {# object follows the rules again.} other {# objects follow the rules again.}}

bulk.failed: The bulk change could not be saved.

sync.fullHint: Reads the whole directory instead of the changes. Runs once a day on its own.

mode.resync: Full sync after an expired delta link

sync.summary: {users, plural, =0 {No changed users} one {# user read} other {# users read}}: {created} added, {updated} updated, {orphaned} orphaned
sync.rescoped: {count, plural, one {# object re-scoped by the rules} other {# objects re-scoped by the rules}}
sync.removedUsers: {count, plural, one {# user left the directory} other {# users left the directory}}

warnings.title: {count, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
warnings.more: {count, plural, one {# more warning is not listed} other {# more warnings are not listed}}
warnings.group_unresolved: The protection group could not be read ({status}). Its members are excluded until it resolves.
warnings.mailbox_probe_failed: Mailbox of {user} could not be checked ({status}); its address decided.
warnings.drive_probe_failed: OneDrive of {user} could not be checked ({status}); left unchanged.
warnings.user_fetch_failed: User {user} could not be read ({status}); the next sync picks it up.

result.alreadyQueued: A directory sync is already queued or running.

notQueued.source_disabled: The source is paused; the change applies once it is resumed.
notQueued.consent_outstanding: The change applies after admin consent and the first sync.
notQueued.queue_unavailable: No sync could be queued because the worker is not running; the next scheduled sync applies the change.

sync.failed: The sync could not be started.

empty.title: No sources yet
empty.description: Connect a Microsoft 365 tenant or an IMAP server under Sources; its mailboxes and accounts show up here.

sources.m365Kinds: {mailbox, plural, one {# mailbox} other {# mailboxes}}, {onedrive, plural, one {# OneDrive} other {# OneDrives}}
sources.consentHint: Grant admin consent for this tenant under Sources before the first sync.
sources.disabledHint: The source is paused. Resume it under Sources to sync again.
sources.manualHint: IMAP servers have no directory. Add accounts by hand or from a CSV file.

rules.title: Rules
rules.sharedOff: Shared and blocked mailboxes left out
rules.exclusions: {count, plural, =0 {No exclusions} one {# exclusion} other {# exclusions}}
rules.overrides: {count, plural, =0 {No individual decisions} one {# individual decision} other {# individual decisions}}

rules.title: Protection rules
rules.description: Which mailboxes and OneDrives of {source} {appName} protects. Saving queues a sync that applies the rules.
rules.precedence: Individual decisions on single objects beat these rules.
rules.selectedHint: Choose what to protect from the Objects tab: select the mailboxes or OneDrives you want and use "Include", there or as a bulk action. Switching scope never deletes a backup: an object that leaves the scope simply stops being backed up and keeps its existing snapshots.

mode.label: Scope
mode.allHint: Every user with a mailbox or OneDrive, including shared and resource mailboxes. Recommended.
mode.groupHint: Only direct and nested members of the group. Everyone else is excluded.
mode.selectedHint: Nobody is protected until an admin explicitly includes a mailbox or OneDrive from the objects list. A new object of an already-included user (for example a OneDrive Microsoft creates on first use) is not included automatically.

group.label: Group
group.search: Search groups by name or paste an object id
group.empty: No group starts with this name.
group.required: Choose a group for this scope.

shared.label: Include shared and blocked mailboxes
shared.hint: Accounts with sign-in disabled: shared and resource mailboxes, but also blocked users. Microsoft Graph does not tell them apart.

exclude.label: Exclusion list
exclude.hint: One entry per line: address, user principal name or object id. Applies before the scope.
exclude.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}

rules.failed: The rules could not be saved.

accounts.title: Add IMAP accounts
accounts.description: Accounts of {source}. With a header row, a password column is accepted for a source with one password per mailbox; it is sealed on arrival and never shown again.
accounts.format: One account per line: login, name, address. A header row (login, name, email, password) in any order is recognised; comma, semicolon and tab all work. A password column only applies with a header row.
accounts.passwordColumnHint: This source has one password per mailbox, so a password column is sealed on arrival.
accounts.passwordColumnIgnoredHint: This source shares one login for every mailbox, so a password column here is ignored.
accounts.fileError: The file could not be read.
accounts.summary: {created, plural, =0 {No new accounts} one {# new account} other {# new accounts}}, {existing, plural, =0 {none listed already} one {# listed already} other {# listed already}}
accounts.done: {created, plural, =0 {No new accounts added} one {# account added} other {# accounts added}}.
accounts.empty: Paste accounts or choose a file, then check the list.

issues.title: {count, plural, one {# line skipped} other {# lines skipped}}

accounts.failed: The accounts could not be added.

mode.shared: This source uses one shared login for every mailbox; no password is needed here.
mode.per_mailbox: This source uses one password per mailbox; set each mailbox's password below.
mode.master_user: This source uses a master account that logs in to every mailbox; no password is needed here.

rowFields.hint: Optional: give each new mailbox its password now. A username is only needed when it differs from the address.

results.missingHint: Mailboxes without a password cannot be backed up yet. Set it from the mailbox's action menu.
